fields.statement: Verified as claude-code-161be154 at 7e7d2ba60. go test -trimpath ./internal/workflow/... ok. go test -trimpath ./internal/api/... ok (379s) from a git-archive copy outside ~/code; run inside ~/code the tests all passed, but the root-state guard flagged .rhiza-root/usage.live.json, which the live root daemon writes, not this change. go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run 'TestScripts/(render-generate|describe-golden)' PASS: render-generate shows daemon settings listing rhiza.ship.generate with an empty default, empty skipping with nothing staged, a build run's render step committing the rewritten tracked file with the Change trailer and a clean tree, and a failing command failing (exit 1, output shown); the render steps chain it with && before rhiza render, so a failure fails the step. This repo's git config sets rhiza.ship.generate=make docs; make docs leaves docs/reference unchanged. make self-check at the leaf commit fails only on stale .rhiza/rendered (the run's render step refreshes it); in a scratch clone after rhiza render, make self-check is ok. Diff read: build.toml/review.toml run ship generate first and commit all staged changes with the Change trailer; ship.generate stages only paths whose status or content changed since before the command.
